headline: Storefront redesign — product detail page + cart
summary: The default storefront's product detail page and cart adopt a retail-feel two-column layout. The PDP swaps the variant table for a media slot plus a radio-driven variant picker, a +/- quantity stepper, a full-width primary CTA, and accordion sections for description, shipping, and returns. The cart switches to an item list paired with a sticky summary sidebar showing subtotal, a tax-and-shipping-at-checkout note, and the primary checkout CTA.

items.title: Product detail page
items.body:
`renderProduct` returns a two-column layout (stacked on narrow viewports). The left column reserves a 1:1 `.pdp-media` slot — when the caller provides `opts.media[0].r2_key` the slot renders ``, otherwise it shows the first variant's SKU as a placeholder badge. The right column renders title, starting price, a 140-char short description, the variant picker, quantity stepper, and the primary CTA. The full description, shipping copy, and returns copy live in `
`/`` accordion sections below the fold so no client JS is required to toggle them.

items.title: Variant picker
items.body: Variants render as a vertical stack of radio cards (`<input type="radio" name="variant_id">`) instead of a table. Each card shows the variant title, SKU as muted secondary text, and price; the selected card glows with the accent color via CSS `:has(input:checked)`. The first variant is preselected so single-variant products are one click to add.

items.title: Quantity stepper
items.body: The PDP and cart-line quantity inputs are wrapped in a `.qty-stepper` component with `−` / `+` buttons (driven by inline JS via `data-step` attributes). The stepper falls back to the bare `<input type="number">` when JS is disabled — the number input still validates `min="1" max="99"` natively and the form posts whatever value is present.

items.title: Cart page
items.body: `renderCart` returns a two-column grid: an item list (`<ul class="cart-lines">`) on the left and a sticky `.summary-table` sidebar on the right. Each line shows the variant title, SKU, an inline quantity stepper, the line total in the accent color, and a quiet text-link Remove control. The summary shows subtotal, a muted "Tax and shipping calculated at checkout" line, total, and a full-width Checkout CTA. A continue-shopping link sits below the line list.

items.title: Empty cart
items.body: The empty-cart view is now a dedicated centered card with a "Browse the shop" primary CTA back to the home page rather than an empty table row.
